cohort: The study included 575 very low birth weight (VLBW) infants born at a single center between January 1, 2005, and December 31, 2013.
finding: Extreme prematurity (gestational age at birth <27 weeks), but not prenatal indomethacin use, was associated with an increased risk of acute kidney injury (AKI) in very low birth weight (VLBW) infants.
gest_age: <28 weeks of gestation for indomethacin administration, with a focus on <27 weeks at birth in findings
